name: Redcare Pharmacy N.V.
summary: Redcare Pharmacy N.V. manages and runs a network of digital pharmacies across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Belgium, Italy, and the Netherlands. The company offers a comprehensive selection of healthcare products, including prescription medications, over-the-counter drugs, pharmacy-related beauty and personal care items, and nutritional supplements. Established in 2001, the firm, initially known as Shop Apotheke Europe N.V., officially rebranded to Redcare Pharmacy N.V. in June 2023. Its operational headquarters are situated in Sevenum, the Netherlands.
